scope: Final runtime, weights, scorer and thresholds frozen before inspecting the second confirmation set. Historical OPEN100 regression and first synthetic stress set are not called unseen.
shape_model: 73 development-only prototypes; CCOEFF_NORMED >= .78; scales .85/1/1.15; no semantic class/standard ID auto-approval
junction_policy: T/endpoints connect, 4-way intersections connect only with a dot; no hidden-gap bridging
reference_scorer: same class-agnostic IoU .50 one-to-one and equipment-adjacency contraction; immutable multi-file baseline snapshot
changes_after_initial_freeze: Initial unconditional v3 was rejected after the predeclared synthetic set regressed. That first set is now a negative engineering/regression set, not held out.

Shape assistance now requires BOTH >=3 matched prototypes and >=2 boxed pointed continuation markers; unsupported inputs keep the exact v2 symbol and connection pipeline. Filename/dataset identity is not used.
Connection cap ordering made independent of random element IDs; same cap of 500, with a dedicated metamorphic test.
Oracle diagnostics reuse the profile selected from the real image; no ground truth is used to select the deployed profile.
